about.title: Hi — I'm Patrik.
paragraphs: I've been writing iOS apps since 2019 — SwiftUI from its first release — and shipping my own since before anyone paid me to. That's the part I'd want you to know first: I've owned releases end to end — signing, submission, review, phased rollout, and the crash report that lands at 7am — for years.

Most recently that's meant SwiftUI at product speed — widgets, HealthKit, Live Activities, a centralized error layer so no failure state is a surprise — and before that, owning a design system for an entire client platform, including the Swift tooling that exported its tokens. I like the boring infrastructure that makes everyone else faster, and I like the low-level detail that nobody asked for. Apex Ryde exists because I wanted to know how a friction circle behaves at 40° of lean.
Outside the editor: motorcycles, the gym, travelling, and books. I live in Brno, work remotely, and speak Slovak, Czech and English.
